_note: GAM Research forecast drivers for Uno Minda Ltd (consolidated, Rs crore). FY26 is the last reported year (revenue Rs19,658 cr incl. Rs69 cr of prior-period income). One reported segment, so revenue is a single growth path computed from the six-division build in `build` and checked in tools/authoring/UNOMINDA.ctx.js. Net profit is on the owners' basis (UNOMINDA.patch.js); the engine has no line for the share of JV profit (post-tax) or minorities, so both enter `otherIncome` grossed up for tax (see _otherIncomeWhy). Valued on P/E, as the street does; the multiple is derived in UNOMINDA.ctx.js and written here by UNOMINDA.val.js.
_revenueWhy: From the division build. FY27E +19.2% on reported FY26 (+19.6% on the Rs19,589 cr ex prior-period income): Q1FY27 grew 26% (normalised) with industry production +22%; from Q3 the base includes the GST 2.0 boost (Sep-2025), so we assume growth slows through the year. Switches +15%, Lighting +12%, Castings +22% (Kharkhoda 4W wheels, Bawal 2W wheels, aluminium pass-through), Green Mobility +60% (Q1 +78%: EV systems, 4W EDU supplies, CNG), Seating +20%, Others +17% (sensors/ADAS, sunroof from end-FY27). FY28E +17.9% and FY29E +16.9%: production +5-7% plus content, new plants (CSN wheels and EV powertrain Q2FY28, 4W seating Q4FY28) and orders already won (2W lamps Rs450 cr peak, seating exports Rs390 cr, sunroof >Rs500 cr). Street FY27E/FY28E revenue: Rs23,438-23,922 cr / Rs27,253-28,344 cr.
_marginWhy: Guidance 11% +/-50bp for FY27 'with a bias towards the higher end' (4-Aug-2026). Q1FY27 10.3% (commodity and wage inflation, ~40bp dilution from at-cost pass-through); FY26 11.1% normalised (11.5% reported incl. the prior-period income); 10.7-12.3% since FY17. FY27E 11.1% assumes ~11.3% for Q2-Q4 as price resets catch up; FY28E 11.4% and FY29E 11.5% as new plants pass their start-up year, partly offset by lower-margin EV and electronics. Street: ICICI Direct 11.1%/11.5%, Emkay 10.8%/11.5%/11.6%.
_capexWhy: FY27E Rs1,750 cr guided (~Rs650 cr sustaining, ~Rs1,100 cr growth, balance land; reiterated 4-Aug-2026). Announced projects Rs3,788 cr, Rs1,406 cr spent by Jun-2026, ~Rs2,000 cr more over 18-24 months. FY26 cash capex Rs1,572 cr. FY28E Rs1,600 cr, FY29E Rs1,500 cr (sustaining ~Rs700 cr plus the tail of announced projects).
_depWhy: FY26 D&A Rs704 cr = 8.2% of average gross block (Rs8,566 cr). Part of capex is land (not depreciated) and the engine depreciates new capex at once while CWIP stays flat, so 7.8%: FY27E ~Rs800 cr (Q1FY27 Rs177 cr; Q4FY26 Rs192 cr; casting is on WDV, so Q1 is seasonally low), FY28E ~Rs930 cr, FY29E ~Rs1,050 cr.
_treasuryWhy: Net debt company: Rs2,179 cr at Mar-2026 (borrowings Rs2,537 cr less cash and bank Rs358 cr; leases Rs203 cr more). Interest income is tiny (deposits Rs8 cr in FY26) and is in the recurring other income below.
_otherIncomeWhy: Built, not plugged: (1) recurring other income Rs28 / 30 / 32 cr (FY26 Rs34 cr incl. Rs5 cr tax-refund interest and Rs6 cr write-backs; Q1FY27 Rs6 cr); (2) share of JV and associate profit, post-tax, Rs270 / 310 / 350 cr (FY26 Rs249 cr, +38%; Q1FY27 Rs48 cr, flat, hit by commodity costs that the company expects to recover from Q2; Toyoda Gosei airbag plant from Q1FY27; Denso Ten IVI order Rs600 cr peak from Q3FY29) less (3) minorities Rs97 / 110 / 124 cr (FY26 Rs87 cr, Q1FY27 Rs20 cr; mostly Tokai Rika's 49% of Uno Mindarika). (2) and (3) are after tax, so they are divided by (1 - 24.5%) because the engine taxes all other income: 28 + (270 - 97) / 0.755 = Rs257 cr. Net profit then equals owners' PAT. FY26 on Screener's basis: other income Rs34 cr + JV Rs249 cr - exceptional Rs28 cr = Rs256 cr; TTM to Jun-26 Rs250 cr.
_interestWhy: FY26 Rs187 cr, Q1FY27 Rs46 cr. Gross debt Rs2,537 cr plus leases Rs203 cr at Mar-2026; FY27 capex above operating cash flow keeps debt rising (MOSL/Emkay see net debt peaking in FY27), easing in FY29E.
_taxWhy: FY26 24.3% and Q1FY27 24.5% of profit before JV share; the new-regime rate is 25.2% with some incentive income.
_payoutWhy: 12-14% of PAT every year FY22-FY26 (FY26 Rs2.65 a share = 12.8%).

build._note: Division build (Rs crore). FY26 base = sum of the four quarters disclosed in the Q4FY26 and Q1FY27 presentations (Rs19,589 cr; excludes Rs69 cr of prior-period income in reported revenue). Checked against model revenue in UNOMINDA.ctx.js.
build._why: Switches: Q1 +20% (4W +24%), Farrukhnagar capacity from Q3FY27, 2W exports. Lighting: Q1 +14%, 4W in consolidation; 2W lamp order (Rs450 cr peak, H2FY28) and new global 4W OEM lift FY28-29. Castings: Q1 +32% (incl. aluminium); 4W wheel capacity to ~7 mn and 2W to ~9.5 mn wheels; CSN Phase 1 Q2FY28. Green Mobility: Q1 +78% to Rs542 cr; Khed EV powertrain H2FY27, CSN Q2FY28 (Rs2,500-3,000 cr peak potential for ~Rs1,200 cr of capex). Seating: Q1 +28%; exports from end-FY28, PV seating Q4FY28. Others: Q1 +21%; sunroof from end-FY27, 2W display Q4FY27.

dcf._betaWhy: Cyclical auto supplier with modest leverage (net debt ~0.3x equity, ~1x EBITDA): beta 1.0, cost of equity 12.5%. Debt is ~4% of enterprise value, so we use the cost of equity as the discount rate (the engine's DCF has no separate WACC in Excel).
dcf._tgWhy: India's nominal GDP grows ~10%; vehicle production ~5-6% a year plus content per vehicle. House range 5-6%: 6%.
dcf._fadeGrowthWhy: Revenue growth fades from ~17% to 8% over 15 years as new categories mature.
dcf._fadeMarginWhy: EBITDA margin held at 11.5%: the company's long-run band (10.7-12.3%) with no pricing power to go higher.
dcf._fadeCapexWhy: Capex falls from ~4.6% of revenue in FY29E to 4.5% (FY22-26 average 7.7% in a heavy build phase; ~4% sustaining plus growth); depreciation 3.5% of revenue (FY26 3.6%).
dcf._jvWhy: FCFF excludes JV profit (cash comes as dividends: Rs137 cr in FY26) and includes minorities' share; JVs enter only at book value (Rs924 cr) through investments in net debt. See the DCF chapter for the effect.

bull.label: Bull
bull.narrative: Industry volumes keep growing high single digits after the GST step; EV powertrain, sunroof, PV seating and exports ramp on time; alloy-wheel penetration rises again; margin reaches the top of the 11-12% band as commodity costs ease.

bear.label: Bear
bear.narrative: Volumes flatten against the GST base; commodity and wage inflation is recovered late; new plants ramp slowly (Inovance JV blocked by Chinese approvals); share losses at a key 4W client continue; margin slips back to ~10.5%.

methods.name: P/E
methods.why: How the street values Uno Minda: P/E on one-year-forward EPS (MOSL 45x FY28E, ICICI Direct 46x, Axis 39x, Emkay 35x). Multiple derived in UNOMINDA.ctx.js and written by UNOMINDA.val.js.

methods.name: EV/EBITDA
methods.why: Values the operating business; the historical multiple already prices the JV stakes, as the market capitalisation includes them.

methods.name: DCF
methods.why: Tests whether cash flows support the price: 15-year FCFF, cost of equity 12.5%, terminal growth 6%, less net debt (JVs at book value).
